import sys
import math

def convoluteSimply(a, b, P, g):
    m = max(2, 1 << (max(a.__len__(), b.__len__()) - 1).bit_length() + 2)
    fa = nttmb(a, m, False, P, g)
    fb = fa if a is b else nttmb(b, m, False, P, g)
    for i in range(m):
        fa[i] = fa[i] * fb[i] % P
    return nttmb(fa, m, True, P, g)

def nttmb(src, n, inverse, P, g):
    dst = src[:n] + [0] * (n - len(src))
    h = n.bit_length() - 1
    K = 1 << (h + 1)
    H = (K.bit_length() - 1) * 2
    M = (K * K) // P
    wws = [0] * (1 << (h - 1))
    dw = pow(g, P - 1 - (P - 1) // n, P) if inverse else pow(g, (P - 1) // n, P)
    w = (1 << 32) % P
    for k in range(1 << (h - 1)):
        wws[k] = int(w)
        w = modh(w * dw, M, H, P)
    J = invl(P, 1 << 32)
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(1 << i):
            s = j << (h - i)
            t = s | 1 << (h - i - 1)
            for k in range(1 << (h - i - 1)):
                u = (dst[s] - dst[t] + 2 * P) * wws[k]
                dst[s] += dst[t]
                if dst[s] >= 2 * P:
                    dst[s] -= 2 * P
                Q = ((u << 32) * J) >> 32
                dst[t] = (u >> 32) - (Q * P >> 32) + P
                s += 1
                t += 1
        if i < h - 1:
            for k in range(1 << (h - i - 2)):
                wws[k] = wws[k * 2]
    for i in range(n):
        if dst[i] >= P:
            dst[i] -= P
    for i in range(n):
        rev = int('{:b}'.format(i).zfill(h)[::-1], 2)
        if i < rev:
            dst[i], dst[rev] = dst[rev], dst[i]
    if inverse:
        in_val = invl(n, P)
        for i in range(n):
            dst[i] = modh(dst[i] * in_val, M, H, P)
    return dst

def modh(a, M, h, mod):
    r = a - ((M * (a & ((1 << 31) - 1)) >> 31) + M * (a >> 31) >> (h - 31)) * mod
    return r if r < mod else r - mod

def pow(a, n, mod):
    ret = 1
    for x in range(n.bit_length() - 1, -1, -1):
        ret = ret * ret % mod
        if (n >> x) & 1:
            ret = ret * a % mod
    return ret

def invl(a, mod):
    b = mod
    p, q = 1, 0
    while b > 0:
        c = a // b
        d = a
        a = b
        b = d % b
        d = p
        p = q
        q = d - c * q
    return p if p >= 0 else p + mod

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    N = int(input_data[0])
    k = int(input_data[1])
    vals = list(map(int, input_data[2:2+k]))
    dig = [0] * 11
    for val in vals:
        dig[10 - val] = 1
    power = N // 2
    res = [1]
    MOD = 998244353
    while power > 0:
        if power & 1:
            res = convoluteSimply(res[:], dig[:], MOD, 3)
        dig = convoluteSimply(dig[:], dig[:], MOD, 3)
        power >>= 1
    output = 0
    for v in res:
        output += v * v
        output %= MOD
    print(output)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
